li.label: terrified by the Marker
li.description: It is right there. I can feel it in my teeth. I cannot think.

li.label: dread of the Marker
li.description: The Marker hums at the edge of my hearing. I keep looking over my shoulder.

li.label: unease near the Marker
li.description: Something about that thing is wrong. I would rather be anywhere else.

li.label: faint unease
li.description: I can still feel the Marker, even from here.

li.label: a hum in the back of the mind
li.description: Something is awake out there. It is quiet, for now.

li.label: the Marker is growing
li.description: It is louder every week. Sleep comes in pieces.

li.label: cannot stop hearing it
li.description: The sound is in the walls, in the water, in my own head.

li.label: the Marker is calling
li.description: I know what it wants. I know it is getting close to having it.

li.label: the Marker is whole
li.description: There is nowhere on this world it cannot reach. I can feel it looking.

li.label: mind fraying
li.description: I keep hearing something that is not there.

li.label: seeing things
li.description: The walls moved. I know the walls moved.

li.label: the signal is in my head
li.description: It is not outside any more.
